sections.heading: Summary
paragraphs: Platform availability held at 99.94% while the team completed the desktop release and reduced the open incident queue from five items to two.
Decision: Keep reliability remediation as the highest operational priority for the week ending 2026-07-26.

sections.heading: Key Metrics
paragraphs: API availability was 99.94%, P95 response time was 420 ms, and successful background-task completion reached 98.7%.
Weekly active organizations increased 4.6% to 3,184, while support first-response time improved from 3.2 hours to 2.4 hours.
Action: Priya Nair will publish the metric variance analysis by 2026-07-21.

sections.heading: Incidents
paragraphs: INC-247 caused 19 minutes of degraded task scheduling on 2026-07-16; retry saturation was mitigated by lowering worker concurrency from 64 to 48.
INC-251 affected 37 desktop sign-ins for 11 minutes on 2026-07-18; token refresh behavior was corrected and no data loss occurred.
Action: Mateo Silva will complete both incident reviews and assign follow-up owners by 2026-07-23.

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: Desktop version 0.9.7 was released to 100% of users on 2026-07-17 with improved startup diagnostics and crash reporting.
Scheduler deployment 2026.07.18-2 added bounded retries and reduced duplicate task executions by 63% in staging validation.
Decision: Hold nonessential scheduler changes until the INC-247 review closes on 2026-07-23.

sections.heading: Next Steps
paragraphs: The reliability team will load-test 10,000 concurrent scheduled tasks and verify recovery under a 30% worker loss scenario.
Support will contact all 37 users affected by INC-251 and confirm successful sign-in before 2026-07-22.
Action: Operations lead Priya Nair will review completion evidence at the 2026-07-24 readiness meeting.
